biggest_catch: The program is limited to the FIRST 100 qualifying referrals - once they're hit, it's over - and the friend must keep the account open 90 days with 15 debit transactions and recurring direct deposit before anyone gets paid.
catches: $100 to both the referring customer and the new customer per qualifying referral; program limited to the first 100 qualifying referrals.

Friend must: open a Neighborhood checking account via the referral link (referral submitted before account opening), keep it open and in good standing 90 days, complete 15 posted POS debit transactions (non-ATM), and establish/maintain recurring payroll/pension/government direct deposit within 90 days.
Friend must not have had a Neighborhood checking account in the previous 12 months.
Rewards paid after verification of the 90-day qualification period, as a deposit into a Neighborhood account.
Referring customer must have an active NNB account in good standing at referral and payout.
NNB employees and Board customers ineligible; NNB can modify/suspend/terminate at any time.
Rewards may be reported to the IRS; taxes the customer's responsibility.

steps: Submit the referral through NNB's official online referral form and share the unique link with your friend.
Friend applies using the referral link and opens a Neighborhood checking account.
Within 90 days, friend completes 15 posted POS debit transactions and establishes recurring direct deposit; keeps account open 90 days.
After verification of the 90-day period, you and your friend each receive $100 (program capped at first 100 referrals).
timing: Rewards paid after verification of the 90-day qualification period (deposit into a Neighborhood account).
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Rewards paid after verification of the 90-day qualification period (deposit into a Neighborhood account). — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
